(=) ENERGY COMBAT
X% 2: Energy attack.
You may search your discard pile for an Ally and
place it into play at 3 stages above 0.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Raise that Ally to its highest power stage.
(Banish after use.)
